summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a Form 6-K on August 12, 2026, reporting that its board granted 15,060 warrants to employees on August 11, 2026, under its Articles of Association. Each warrant is exercisable for one ordinary share at $254.57, the closing price on the grant date, with vesting over four years subject to continued service. The filing also includes an amended Articles of Association and notes 1,524,443 warrants remain available for future grant. This is a routine equity incentive grant, not a special situation. No deal terms, premium, or acquisition activity is involved; the disclosure is standard for a foreign private issuer.
